description: `allow_accept` was REMOVED in v0.6, and this vector pins that the removal is SPEC-SURFACE only. `permissions` carries no `additionalProperties: false`, so a pre-0.6 sender still emitting the field submits successfully and §10 robustness has the Hub ignore it. Rejecting would have been gratuitous breakage: the field never had semantics, so no sender ever meant anything by it.
